g.text: Stack-safe PropertyValue: logical tree, flat ownership, bounded persistence
Every child node precedes its parent.
A non-null root is the final node.
Standalone Null is the empty canonical arena.
Each List stores one checked range in E.
Ranges partition E in node order.
Every non-root node has exactly one parent.
Native call depth is constant in logical depth.
Counted list cursors retain O(depth) live obligations,
while N and E retain O(nodes + edges) owned data.
